title: dracocephalum stewartianum
intro: Dracocephalum stewartianum, commonly known as Stewart's dragonhead or Stewart's dragon-head, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues, including its purported anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. However, more research is needed to confirm the effectiveness and safety of using D. stewartianum for medicinal purposes.
